senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (शुल्कयति)
1 To speak.
2 To gain or acquire.
3 To create.
4 To abandon, to leave or forsake.

mn. (-ल्कः-ल्कं)
1 Toll, duty, customs or taxes.
2 A present made by the bridegroom to the bride, at the time of bringing her home to his family; a marriage settlement or dower.
3 Money given to the parents of the bride.
4 Money given at the purchase of any thing to ratify the bargain.
5 The profits of household labour, employment of domestic utensils, care of milch cattle, preservation of ornaments, superintendence of servants, &c. when considered as the perquisite of the wife and her own legal property.
E.
शुल्क to quit, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
Any object of taxation or duty.
E.
शुल्क, and स्थान place.

f. (-निः)
Loss or forfeiture of wages, dower, &c.
E.
शुल्क, and हानि privation.

n. (-ल्लं)
A cord, a rope or string.

r. 1st cl. (शूलति)
1 To disorder, to distemper or disease.
2 To make a loud noise.
3 To impale, to transfix.

mn. (-लः-लं)
1 Sharp pain in general, or especially in the belly, as cholic, &c. or in the joints, from rheumatism^1 or gout.
2 A weapon, a pike, a dart.
3 An iron pin or spit.
4 A banner, an ensign.
5 An astrological Yoga, that of the 9th lunar mansion.
6 Death, dying.
f. (-ला)
1 A whore.
2 An instrument used for putting criminals to death, a stake for impaling them.
E.
शूल to disease, &c., aff. अच्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

r. 10th cl. (शुल्वयति)
1 To measure.
2 To create.

subst. mfn. (-ल्वः-ल्वा-ल्वी-ल्वं)
1 A rope, a cord, a string.
n. (-ल्वं)
1 Copper.
2 A sacrificial observance.
3 Institute, law.
4 A quantity of water.
E.
शुल्व to measure, aff. अच्; or शुघ to be pure, &c., Uṇādi aff. वन्, and ध changed to ल.

m. (-रिः)
Sulphur.
E.
शुल्व copper, and अरि a foe.

m. (-कः)
A restive horse.
E.
शूल to distress, वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Iron rust or filings.
E.
शूल pain, and घातन what removes.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Removing or allaying sharp pain, sedative, anodyne.
E.
शूल, and घ्न what destroys.

m. (-न्वा)
ŚIVA.
E.
शूल a pike or the three-pronged one, the trident of this deity, धन्वन् a bow, put for a weapon.

m. (-रः)
ŚIVA.
f. (-रा)
DURGĀ.
E.
शूल a pike or trident, धर who holds.

f. (-धृक्)
DURGĀ.
E.
शूल a trident, and धृष to be bold, aff. क्विप्.

n. (-नं)
White Sochal salt.
E.
शूल cholic, and नाशन removing.

m. (-त्रुः)
The castor oil plant, (Ricinus communis.)
E.
शूल cholic, and शत्रु hostile.

m. (-स्तः)
One armed with a lance or pike.
E.
शूल, and हस्त the hand.

m. (-हृत्)
Asafoetida.
E.
शूल cholic, and हृत् removing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Roasted on a spit, (meat.)
E.
शूल a spit, and कृत made, with डाच् augment, spitted.

n. (-ग्रं)
The point of a pike, stake, &c.
E.
शूल, and अग्र end.

n. (-कं)
Roat meat.
m. (-कः)
A hare.
E.
शूल a spit, and ठ् aff.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Suffering sharp pain, having the cholic, &c.
m. (-ली)
1 MAHĀDEVA.
2 A spearman.
3 A stakebearer.
E.
शूल a trident, and इनि aff.

m. (-नः)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
शूल a stake, इनन् aff.

f. (-त्खा)
A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
1 Roasted, (on a spit.)
2 Deserving impalement.
n. (-ल्यं)
Roasted meat.
E.
शूल a spit, and यत् aff.

n. (-णं)
Ascertaining, determining.
f. (-णा)
One of DURGĀ'S female companions.
E.
सु good, लक्षण a mark.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well-determined or ascertained.
E.
सु, and लक्षित marked.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Easy, feasible, attainable, of easy acquisition or attainment, not difficult to be obtained or effected.
E.
सु ready, and लभ acquiring; opposed to दुर्लभ or difficult.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sporting gracefully.
2 Pleased, happy.
n. adv. (-तं)
Delightedly, easily.
E.
सु, and ललित sported.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fine-eyed.
m. (-नः)
1 A deer.
2 DURYODHANA.
f. (-ना)
A handsome woman.
E.
सु excellent, and लोचन an eye.

n. (-कं)
Brass.
E.
सु good, लोह iron, and कन् added.

mfn. (-तः-ता or हिणी-तं)
Very red.
f. (-ता)
One of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire.
E.
सु very, लोहित red.
